name: Windbreak Canyon
summary: Wind serpents hunt travelers along the northern road through Windbreak Canyon. The canyon lies between Freewind Post and the Shimmering Flats.

sections.title: A Serpent Nest in the Needles
sections.body: East of Freewind Post, Windbreak Canyon cuts through the sheer northern walls above the canyon floor. Whistling winds race between the stone spires, leaving little shelter. Wild wind serpents perch among the rocks, lay clutches on the ledges, and strike travelers who stray from the main road. Winding trails climb through the canyon toward the Weathered Nook.

faq.answer: Windbreak Canyon runs along the northern side of Thousand Needles, between Freewind Post and the eastern approach to the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: What creatures live in Windbreak Canyon?
faq.answer: Aggressive wild wind serpents nest among the canyon's crags and defend their clutches from intruders.

faq.q: Where does the trail inside the canyon lead?
faq.answer: Winding trails climb through the canyon toward the Weathered Nook in the cliffs above.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can study and tame the agile wind serpents that nest throughout the canyon and spit lightning.
